entities.name: Sima
entities.description: A blue mage of the Dark Age and early Ice Age from the City of Shadows in Lat-Nam, Jodah's first wife.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Archmage who met Sima in Ghed, married her, and became Archmage Eternal.

entities.name: Mother Dobbs
entities.description: Crone for whom Jodah sold Alabaster Potions.

entities.name: Ghed
entities.description: City-state where Sima and Jodah first met.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: Sima's home in Lat-Nam, where Jodah became Archmage Eternal.

entities.name: Voska
entities.description: Mage Sima hoped to recruit for the City of Shadows.

entities.name: Alsoor
entities.description: Place Sima went to chasing a rumor of Voska.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: Church of Tal leader who trapped Sima.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church that imprisoned Sima and slated her for execution.

entities.name: Togath
entities.description: Man whom Sima knocked out with Amnesia.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Mage group whose fall Sima helped bring about by freeing Lord Ith.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Prisoner freed by Jodah and Sima.

events.summary: Sima and Jodah first meet in Ghed; guards interrupt and Sima escapes with her spell Unbalancing.
events.quote: Sima and Jodah met for the first time in the city-state of Ghed

events.summary: Sima falls into Delphine's trap in Alsoor and is imprisoned by the Church of Tal, slated for execution.
events.quote: Sima was thus imprisoned by the Church of Tal and was slated for execution.

events.summary: Jodah sneaks into Sima's cell; she teaches him to disenchant her manacles and knocks out Togath.
events.quote: Sima taught Jodah how to disenchant her moonsilver manacles

events.summary: Sima helps Jodah free Lord Ith at the Conclave of Mages, contributing to its fall; they go to the City of Shadows.
events.quote: where she helped Jodah free Lord Ith , thus contributing to the Fall of the Conclave of Mages

events.summary: Sima dies of old age after the start of the Ice Age with Jodah at her bedside.
events.quote: Jodah sat by her bedside when she passed away.

relations.quote: Jodah and Sima were later married
immediately fell into a trap set by Primata Delphine
